en: Since you keep coming to see me every day,
I thought something was odd.
(That saves me the trouble of explaining.)
You'll help me, then?
Got it. If it's a stowaway passage, I can arrange that somehow

So. At night. I. Hit. People.

en: The domination of humans is proceeding smoothly.
Hello.
Look, I've got no business with you.
Your father asked me
note: Pairs with M1#424 'to be your tutor' (msg 18114) and #335

en: to be your tutor, but...
Yeah, I heard about it.
But at this hour,
no way I'm studying.
Sorry, but come back later.
It's a real pain, you showing up at this hour.
You don't have to come at this hour.
You're a tutor, after all.
Come during the day.
Teach me more, about all kinds of things!
I'm definitely gonna rule this world!
, you cheer me on, too.
What do you want?
If you wanna talk to my old man, go to City Hall.
So it's you. The new tutor.
Just so you know,

en: I have no intention of studying at all.
note: Full sentence so it follows both #350 and #441

en: I have no intention of teaching you anything, either.
So what are you gonna do?
If I tell my old man what you just said,
you'll be fired on the spot.
I was only given the job because of how the talk went.
I don't intend to keep doing this work.
Well, well.
Now this is interesting.
I'll tell my old man I'm
getting taught properly.
Just drop by my place once in a while.
Slack off just enough not to get fired.
I've got no business with you!
If you wanna talk to my old man, go to City Hall!
I never expected you to be the new tutor.
Slack off just enough not to get fired,
and just drop by my place.
Damn, every day is so boring.
I get nothing out of school anyway.
Isn't there anything fun to do?
Hey, are you listening?!
, man.

en: Yeah.
Why are you in Calstatt, anyway?
note: No used_in; speaker/order of #375-#387 inferred (Ludwig asks, PLAYER answers #377)

en: You don't seem to have any other job, either.
I'm on my way to London.
Really?
You're going to London!
Lucky you.
I tried to go once myself.
I hid in a barrel in the harbor warehouse.
The one in front of the London-bound ship.
So, when I figured I'd been loaded onto the ship,
I climbed out.
And what do you know? I wasn't on a ship,
I was at the Calstatt market!
Oops, time's almost up. You can go now.
Isn't there, like, anything fun to do?!
I'm already sick of kid stuff.
Something that'd give me a real thrill,
that's what I'm looking for.
Hey, you're my tutor, right?!
Why don't you teach me something once in a while!
Isn't there anything thrilling and fun?!
People...
Ruling humans is said to be fun, you know.
Sure, it sounds like fun. But
there's no way anyone could do that!
